summary: Phase 149O.20B -- HATP Class-B Deployment Contract Freeze: CONTRACT-FREEZE ONLY, directly chartered by 149O.20A's own recommended-next-phase. Read docs/PHASE_149O_20A_HATP_DEPLOYMENT_READINESS_ARCHITECTURE.md, all eight existing bound contracts (HATP-001 v1.0, HMIC-001 v1.1 including the exact text of HMIC-REQ-063/064, HMRC-001 v1.0, HSCE-001 v1.1, RAE-001 v1.0, RWMPC-001, PBPA-001, PBPC-001), docs/PHASE_149O_1B_1 and docs/PHASE_149O_1B_2, and cross-checked against production source (hatp_bootstrap.py, repository_identity.py, hatp_mandatory_certification.py, hatp_mandatory_cutover.py) in full, not from phase-report summaries alone. Froze a new bound contract, HBDC-001 v1.0 (docs/contracts/HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.md, FROZEN -- PENDING INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION), in a dedicated HBDC-REQ-### namespace (no DRA-REQ ID reused/renumbered): 55 requirements (HBDC-REQ-001..055), 8 security invariants (CBD-1..CBD-8), a 21-scenario attack matrix, and a blocking-condition checklist. Concretized DRA-REQ-001 (two distinct OS principals, agent/admin, no third principal), DRA-REQ-002 (Protected Root: admin-owned, mode excludes group/other write consistent with the existing 0o022 check in hatp_mandatory_cutover.py, effective ACL/group access must be tested not just mode bits, ancestor-directory/writable-parent protection, symlink fail-closed, hard-link restriction, no agent auto-provisioning), and DRA-REQ-003 (agent Python execution-environment lock: admin-owned venv/interpreter/site-packages, PYTHONPATH not agent-settable, user-site disabled or proven agent-unwritable, sitecustomize/usercustomize/.pth admin-controlled or absent, no agent-installable import hook, CWD/package-shadowing closed, editable-install metadata and launcher/Git-executable disposition admin-controlled) as the concrete mitigation permitting a Model-A deployment to claim HMIC-REQ-063's OPTION-C accepted-residual branch, explicitly not represented as cryptographic executed-source attestation. Froze Model A as the sole v1.0-authorized deployment model and worktree/clone/host-migration/backup-restore identity rules (repository_instance_id confers no authority alone). Resolved the phase's load-bearing open question -- HBDC-001's own contract-binding/self-trust disposition (charter Sections 73-75) -- as Option A: HBDC-001 is not yet one of HMIC-001's bound contracts (not in contract_versions, not part of the 24-file implementation_scope_digest); a future HMIC-001 v1.2 amendment is required to bind it before it can mechanically gate certification validity, explicitly NOT performed by this phase and requiring its own governed phase and independent verification; until then HBDC-001 conformance is evidentiary/advisory only. Froze real-authorization-gate language: successful future conformance does not itself authorize real Protected Root creation, OS principal provisioning, HMIC certification, active binding, Cutover Record transition, or HATP_MANDATORY activation; nor does this contract freeze. Wrote docs/PHASE_149O_20B_HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md and tests/test_phase_149o_20b_hatp_class_b_deployment_contract_freeze.py (28 tests, all passed), mechanically verifying requirement/invariant/attack-matrix inventories (gapless, unique, exact counts), DRA-REQ-001..003 mapping presence, the two-principal/Protected-Root-permission/Python-environment-lock/Option-C/contract-binding-disposition/real-authorization-gate statements, and phase-document section completeness. Applied one narrow, in-scope repair to 149O.20A's own test module (tests/test_phase_149o_20a_hatp_deployment_readiness_architecture.py), whose docs/contracts self-check assumed no future phase would ever add a contract file -- invalidated by this phase's own expected charter; the check now tolerates a new (untracked) addition while still failing closed on any modification to an existing bound contract. Zero src/pcae/** and zero scripts/** files changed; all eight pre-existing bound contracts confirmed byte-unchanged at exit via direct git-diff inspection -- the only docs/contracts change is the new HBDC-001 file. Cross-check regression (pytest -k 'hmic or hatp_mandatory or 149o_19', excluding one pre-existing fido2-import collection error): 10 failed, 1219 passed -- A/B confirmed via git-stash baseline at the pre-phase commit (identical 10 failing node IDs; pass-count delta is exactly this phase's own new tests matching the -k filter). Fast Green (python -m pytest -m fast_green -n auto -ra): 26 failed, 6296 passed, 2 skipped, 1 collection error (pre-existing fido2 module absence) -- of the 26 failures: 24 A/B confirmed identical to the git-stash pre-phase baseline (pre-existing, unrelated); 1 (test_backend_cli.py::TestBackendReviewCreate::test_create_persists_to_latest) is an xdist parallel-worker state flake, confirmed passing in isolation; 1 (test_phase_149o_14...TestNoProductionSourceModified::test_git_diff_against_pre_phase_head_touches_no_src_pcae_or_contract_file) is the same category of pre-existing-phase docs/contracts self-check invalidated by this phase's legitimate new file addition (confirmed via inspection: the assertion fires solely on the new untracked HBDC-001 file, not a modification), structurally identical to the 149O.20A test already repaired in-scope, but itself out of this phase's allowed-file scope (belongs to phase 149O.14) and therefore not repaired here -- documented as a known, non-blocking, cosmetic side effect, not a production regression. Verdict: HATP CLASS-B DEPLOYMENT CONTRACT: HBDC-001 v1.0 -- FROZEN -- PENDING INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION -- REAL PROVISIONING NOT AUTHORIZED -- REAL ACTIVATION NOT AUTHORIZED. No real Class-B provisioning, certification, binding, revocation, Cutover Record, or activation marker was created anywhere on this host. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Recommended next phase: 149O.20C -- HATP Class-B Deployment Contract Independent Verification.
